label: ʿAql · عقل
scope: Using reason. Every occurrence of this root is verbal.

label: ʿIlm · علم
scope: The noun for knowledge. A verse can concern divine knowledge, human knowledge or a limit on it.

label: Knowing and teaching · علم
scope: Knowing, teaching, learning, more or most knowing, learned and all-knowing forms. The speaker or subject matters. ‘Worlds,’ markers and mountains are excluded.

label: Ḥikmah · حكمة
scope: The wisdom noun. Repeated words within a verse are counted separately.

label: Ḥukm · حكم
scope: Judgment, authority or ruling according to context.

label: Ḥakīm · حكيم
scope: The wise or firmly ordered epithet, including descriptions of God or of revelation. Inspect the referent.

label: Fahm · فهم
scope: Being made to understand a particular matter.

label: Fiqh / tafaqquh · فقه
scope: To understand, including acquiring understanding of religion.

label: Tafakkur and thinking · فكر
scope: Reflection or thought. The surrounding passage can criticize thinking directed to a harmful end.

label: Tadabbur · تدبر
scope: Pondering or considering carefully. Other senses of the root are excluded.

label: Albāb · ألباب
scope: Understanding in expressions for people endowed with understanding.

label: Nuhā · نهى
scope: Discernment in the expression for people of intellect. Prohibiting and ceasing are other forms.

label: Baṣīrah / baṣāʾir · بصيرة / بصائر
scope: Insight, clear evidence or perception, depending on context.

label: Burhān · برهان
scope: Proof or demonstration.

label: Tabayyun · تبين
scope: Ascertain or become clear. Only some occurrences direct an investigation.

label: Bayyinah · بينة
scope: A clear sign or proof. Many occurrences concern revelation.

label: Shūrā / consultation · شورى
scope: Mutual consultation or seeking counsel.

label: ʿIbrah / iʿtibār · عبرة / اعتبار
scope: A lesson or an invitation to draw one.

label: Istinbāṭ · استنباط
scope: Drawing out the meaning or implications of a report.

label: Yaqīn · يقين
scope: Certainty and related forms. Includes religious conviction.

label: Ẓann · ظن
scope: Supposition, expectation or conviction. The meaning and moral evaluation vary with context.

label: Rushd · رشد
scope: Right guidance, maturity or sound judgment in context.

label: Ḥalīm · حليم
scope: Forbearing. Includes divine attributes and human dispositions.
